title: GTA6 Community Map V16 Update Brings Major Scale and Detail Overhauls
description: The GTA6 Community Map V16 has arrived, featuring updated coastlines, expanded Vice City architecture, heightmap adjustments, and a 21k x 20k scale based on leaks.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Community Map V16 Update Brings Major Scale and Detail Overhauls

While fans worldwide patiently await the next official wave of information from Rockstar Games regarding *Grand Theft Auto VI*, the dedicated community continues to push the boundaries of fan-made cartography. Recently, a major update for the **GTA6 Community Map V16** was shared on the r/GTA6 Reddit community by user /u/poorna_sus14, offering the most detailed look yet at how players are piecing together the fictional state of Leonida.

Please note that this map is entirely a community-driven project based on leaks and speculation (unconfirmed rumor), and does not represent official Rockstar Games assets.

### What's New in Version 16?

The V16 update builds heavily upon previous iterations, incorporating recent community findings and leak data to refine the geography of the upcoming game world:

* **Leak-Based Alignments**: V16 is built upon the August 18 leaked map layout, with adjusted landmasses, coastlines, urban zones, beaches, and county borders to match the source material.
* **Expanded Infrastructure**: A massive influx of roads and buildings has been added to Vice City, Key Lento, Hamlet, Capri, Ambrosia, and other regions inspired by leaks and extended footage.
* **Elevation & Scale Adjustments**: The elevation maps have been completely updated using leaked heightmap data, alongside a recalibration of the map's overall scale.
* **Landmarks & Zoning**: Various labels across the map have been repositioned and confirmed, alongside the introduction of new "Park" and "Industrial" zones.
* **Vice City Deep Dive**: Buildings surrounding Vice City have received more detailed modeling, including newly placed helipads on rooftops, Crosstown safehouse interiors, Effluvia interiors, and newly mapped alleys in Vice Beach, Downtown, and Southside.
* **Signage & Facilities**: New road signs have been placed along confirmed routes, and the Leonida Penitentiary layout has been notably improved.
* **Grid System Overhaul**: The map has adopted a standardized 1km x 1km grid, bringing the total updated map dimensions to 21k x 20k.

### The Power of Community Collaboration

Projects of this scale require immense collective effort. The V16 update also highlights a refreshed list of contributing users in its credits, showcasing the dedication of the Reddit community in cross-referencing every piece of available media.

## Editor's Take

Even though the GTA6 Community Map V16 is an unverified, community-created project, the sheer dedication behind it is remarkable. By meticulously stitching together leaked heightmaps, road networks, and regional details, the community has built an impressive conceptual blueprint of Leonida. It serves as a fascinating testament to fan passion while we await official updates from Rockstar.
